goal: Ensure transactions sent via private broadcast are accepted into the mempool before returning success
Prevent third-party wallet failures and unblock future private broadcast support in the wallet
agreement: Unaddressed objection: synchronous waiting could cause wallet hangs leading to double payments (instagibbs)
Asks which third-party software currently requires synchronous mempool acceptance (instagibbs)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it unblocks private transaction broadcast integration in the wallet
It provides the synchronization needed by external broadcast clients

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it allows callers to wait for mempool inclusion rather than returning immediately
It fixes broken assumptions for third-party wallets and services using sendrawtransaction
